name: MCP server for AI agents
description: Lets outside AI agents (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, other MCP clients) read this laboratory's orders, results, worklists, statistics and test catalog through the Model Context Protocol. Read-only. Each agent gets its own token from an administrator; patient names and identifiers only for tokens that are allowed them. Every call is rate limited and recorded.

config.label: Calls per agent token per minute
Calls per agent token per day
Days the add-on keeps its record of calls (local regulation may require longer)
Time zone of the laboratory's day, for the daily limit (IANA name, e.g. Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh)
Browser origins allowed to call the MCP endpoint, comma separated (empty: the laboratory's own address)
